review_method: Each of the twenty saved PNGs was opened and visually inspected using view_image. This is a visual review, not independent execution of the UI steps.
scope: Ten exact current model revisions on a flat prepared site: visible facade, ground/support contact and controlled same-camera partial occlusion only.
limitations: These are elevated framed captures, not eye-level interior or fine glazing-optics inspections.
Several frames crop upper roof or tower details; they do not establish complete silhouette quality. Seniors uses a wider framing.
A transient synthetic foreground strip was used to test occlusion; it is not a proposed scene object.
Retain the previously approved architectural reviews for full-model fidelity, interiors, fine details and stated model limitations.
No student-laptop performance, natural-terrain support, arbitrary stretching, operable doors or repeatable floors are certified by this review.
Saved identity, native scale, min/max edits, reload and download byte checks are documented separately by the trial and readback reviewers.

entries.observations: Visible facade/support contact and same-camera partial occlusion remain coherent. No actionable P0/P1 defect apparent within these frames.
